lifecycle_paths.reviewer_question: Which framework version and deployment settings determine lifecycle behavior for `access_jwt`?

findings.title: JWT `legacy_access_jwt` expiry enforcement is disabled or absent
findings.description: Evidence shows this JWT validation path does not enforce expiration.
findings.suggested_fix: Require expiration enforcement when validating JWTs.
findings.reviewer_question: Can expired tokens be accepted on this path?

findings.title: JWT `legacy_access_jwt` verification has no audience evidence
findings.description: JWT verification evidence does not include an expected audience check.
findings.suggested_fix: Require an expected audience when verifying JWTs.
findings.reviewer_question: Should this service reject tokens with an unexpected audience?

findings.title: JWT `legacy_access_jwt` verification has no issuer evidence
findings.description: JWT verification evidence does not include an expected issuer check.
findings.suggested_fix: Require an expected issuer when verifying JWTs.
findings.reviewer_question: Should this service reject tokens with an unexpected issuer?

findings.title: JWT `legacy_access_jwt` verification has no not-before validation evidence
findings.description: JWT verification evidence does not show `nbf` / not-before claim enforcement.
findings.suggested_fix: Require or enforce `nbf` validation where issuer policy uses not-before claims.
findings.reviewer_question: Do issued tokens for this path use `nbf`, and is it enforced in production?

findings.title: JWT `access_jwt` verification has no not-before validation evidence

findings.title: JWT `access_jwt` expiry enforcement relies on library defaults
findings.description: JWT validation appears to rely on the library default for expiration enforcement.
findings.suggested_fix: Make expiration enforcement explicit or document the library version and default.
findings.reviewer_question: Which JWT library version and settings determine expiration enforcement here?
